name: HDPJoin Discovery Analytics
business_purpose: Provide consent-aware HDPJoin funnel analytics to authorized HDP services through SACO's existing read-only google_analytics connector backed by GoogleAnalyticsCollector-CDK.

ga4.note: Existing HDP property; verify GA4 hostname and conversion event collection in production, including www alias behavior.

gsc.note: Separate Search Console domain property; requires independent property creation/verification and service-account access.

requested_capabilities.name: discovery.analytics.fetch
requested_capabilities.scope: single hostname hdpjoin.com, aggregate metrics only, authorized tenants

requested_capabilities.name: discovery.referrals.fetch
requested_capabilities.scope: aggregate HDPJoin-to-HDP handoff counts; no identifying visitor data

output.privacy: aggregate only; no raw IP, email, token, full URL query, or respondent data

operator_actions: Confirm GA4 hostName breakdown includes hdpjoin.com
Confirm CDK direct-Google collector and latest successful receipt
Extend SACO analytics.fetch site allowlist only through approved VPS release
Perform authenticated read-only smoke tests and capture signed operator receipt
Promote connector state only after verified live response
